title.sl: Mešani pogoji: if I'd listened, unless
title.de: Gemischte Bedingungen: if I'd listened, unless
title.it: Condizioni miste: if I'd listened, unless
title.en: If I'd listened, I'd be there now

goal.sl: Pomešaš takrat in zdaj (If I'd listened, I'd be there now), poveš pogoj z unless, as long as, provided that, in ločiš in case od if.
goal.de: Du mischst damals und jetzt (If I'd listened, I'd be there now), sagst eine Bedingung mit unless, as long as, provided that und unterscheidest in case von if.
goal.it: Mescoli allora e adesso (If I'd listened, I'd be there now), dici una condizione con unless, as long as, provided that e distingui in case da if.
goal.en: You can mix then and now (If I'd listened, I'd be there now), set a condition with unless, as long as, provided that, and tell in case from if.

say.sl: Takrat in zdaj se lahko mešata: **If I'd listened, I'd be there now.** (Če bi takrat {m:poslušal|f:poslušala}, bi bil{m:|f:a} zdaj tam.) **if** + **had** + deležnik za to, kar je bilo takrat, **would** + osnovna oblika za to, kar je zdaj.
say.de: Damals und jetzt können sich mischen: **If I'd listened, I'd be there now.** (Hätte ich zugehört, wäre ich jetzt dort.) **if** + **had** + Partizip für das, was damals war, **would** + Grundform für das, was jetzt ist.
say.it: Allora e adesso si possono mescolare: **If I'd listened, I'd be there now.** (Se avessi ascoltato, adesso sarei lì.) **if** + **had** + participio per ciò che è stato, **would** + forma base per ciò che è adesso.
say.en: Then and now can mix: **If I'd listened, I'd be there now.** **if** + **had** + the participle for what happened then, **would** + the base form for what is so now.

examples.en: If I'd listened, I'd be there now.
examples.sl: Če bi takrat {m:poslušal|f:poslušala}, bi bil{m:|f:a} zdaj tam.
examples.de: Hätte ich zugehört, wäre ich jetzt dort.
examples.it: Se avessi ascoltato, adesso sarei lì.

examples.en: If we'd left early, we'd be home by now.
examples.sl: Če bi šli zgodaj, bi bili zdaj že doma.
examples.de: Wären wir früh gegangen, wären wir jetzt schon daheim.
examples.it: Se fossimo partiti presto, adesso saremmo già a casa.

ask.prompt: I didn't sleep. If I ___, I wouldn't be so tired now.

say.sl: Tudi tu sta dva **'d**: **If I'd listened, I'd be there now.** Prvi **'d** je **had** (za if), drugi **would** (pred osnovno obliko). Zanikano **hadn't**, **wouldn't**: **If it hadn't rained, we wouldn't be so wet.** (Če ne bi deževalo, ne bi bili tako mokri.)
say.de: Auch hier zwei **'d**: **If I'd listened, I'd be there now.** Das erste **'d** ist **had** (nach if), das zweite **would** (vor der Grundform). Verneint **hadn't**, **wouldn't**: **If it hadn't rained, we wouldn't be so wet.** (Hätte es nicht geregnet, wären wir nicht so nass.)
say.it: Anche qui due **'d**: **If I'd listened, I'd be there now.** Il primo **'d** è **had** (dopo if), il secondo **would** (prima della forma base). Al negativo **hadn't**, **wouldn't**: **If it hadn't rained, we wouldn't be so wet.** (Se non avesse piovuto, non saremmo così bagnati.)
say.en: Here too two **'d**: **If I'd listened, I'd be there now.** The first **'d** is **had** (after if), the second **would** (before the base form). With not **hadn't**, **wouldn't**: **If it hadn't rained, we wouldn't be so wet.**

examples.en: If it hadn't rained, we wouldn't be so wet.
examples.sl: Če ne bi deževalo, ne bi bili tako mokri.
examples.de: Hätte es nicht geregnet, wären wir nicht so nass.
examples.it: Se non avesse piovuto, non saremmo così bagnati.

say.sl: **if** + preteklik, **would have** + deležnik je obratno: kar je vedno, in kar je bilo takrat: **If I knew the way, I wouldn't have got lost.** (Če bi {m:poznal|f:poznala} pot, se ne bi {m:izgubil|f:izgubila}.) Poti ne poznam, zato sem se izgubil{m:|f:a}.
say.de: **if** + Vergangenheit, **would have** + Partizip ist umgekehrt: was immer so ist und was damals war: **If I knew the way, I wouldn't have got lost.** (Wenn ich den Weg kennen würde, hätte ich mich nicht verirrt.) Ich kenne ihn nicht, darum habe ich mich verirrt.
say.it: **if** + il passato, **would have** + participio è al contrario: ciò che è sempre e ciò che è stato: **If I knew the way, I wouldn't have got lost.** (Se conoscessi la strada, non mi sarei pers{m:o|f:a}.) Non la conosco, perciò mi sono pers{m:o|f:a}.
say.en: **if** + the past, **would have** + the participle is the other way round: what is always so, and what happened then: **If I knew the way, I wouldn't have got lost.** I don't know it, so I got lost.

examples.en: If I knew the way, I wouldn't have got lost.
examples.sl: Če bi {m:poznal|f:poznala} pot, se ne bi {m:izgubil|f:izgubila}.
examples.de: Wenn ich den Weg kennen würde, hätte ich mich nicht verirrt.
examples.it: Se conoscessi la strada, non mi sarei pers{m:o|f:a}.

say.sl: **unless** pomeni če ne: **We'll go unless it rains.** (Šli bomo, če ne bo deževalo.) En ne je dovolj: **We won't go unless it stops.** (Ne bomo šli, če ne preneha.) Za njim je sedanjik, brez will.
say.de: **unless** heißt wenn nicht: **We'll go unless it rains.** (Wir gehen, wenn es nicht regnet.) Ein nicht genügt: **We won't go unless it stops.** (Wir gehen nicht, außer es hört auf.) Danach das Präsens, kein will.
say.it: **unless** vuol dire se non: **We'll go unless it rains.** (Andremo, se non piove.) Basta un no: **We won't go unless it stops.** (Non andremo, a meno che non smetta.) Dopo c'è il presente, niente will.
say.en: **unless** means if not: **We'll go unless it rains.** One not is enough: **We won't go unless it stops.** After it comes the present, no will.

examples.sl: Šli bomo, če ne bo deževalo.
examples.de: Wir gehen, wenn es nicht regnet.

examples.en: We won't go unless it stops.

examples.de: Wir gehen nicht, außer es hört auf.

say.sl: **as long as**, **provided that**, **providing** pomenijo samo če: **You can have the van as long as you bring it back.** (Kombi lahko vzameš, če ga le vrneš.) **You can stay provided that you help.** (Lahko ostaneš, če le pomagaš.)
say.de: **as long as**, **provided that**, **providing** heißen nur wenn: **You can have the van as long as you bring it back.** (Du kannst den Lieferwagen haben, solange du ihn zurückbringst.) **You can stay provided that you help.** (Du kannst bleiben, vorausgesetzt, du hilfst.)
say.it: **as long as**, **provided that**, **providing** vogliono dire solo se: **You can have the van as long as you bring it back.** (Puoi prendere il furgone, purché lo riporti.) **You can stay provided that you help.** (Puoi restare, a patto che tu aiuti.)
say.en: **as long as**, **provided that**, **providing** mean only if: **You can have the van as long as you bring it back.** **You can stay provided that you help.**

say.sl: **in case** pove, kaj narediš prej, ker se lahko zgodi: **Take a coat in case it rains.** (Vzemi plašč, za primer da bo deževalo.) **if** je drugače: **Take a coat if it rains.** (Vzemi plašč, če bo deževalo.) Tudi za preteklost: **I took a coat in case it rained.** V govoru ljudje rečejo tudi *If I'd have listened*. Pisno velja **If I had listened**.
say.de: **in case** sagt, was du vorher tust, weil es geschehen kann: **Take a coat in case it rains.** (Nimm einen Mantel mit, falls es regnet.) **if** ist anders: **Take a coat if it rains.** (Nimm einen Mantel, wenn es regnet.) Auch für damals: **I took a coat in case it rained.** Gesprochen sagt man auch *If I'd have listened*. Geschrieben gilt **If I had listened**.
say.it: **in case** dice che cosa fai prima, perché può succedere: **Take a coat in case it rains.** (Prendi un cappotto, nel caso piova.) **if** è diverso: **Take a coat if it rains.** (Prendi un cappotto, se piove.) Anche per il passato: **I took a coat in case it rained.** A voce si dice anche *If I'd have listened*. Per iscritto vale **If I had listened**.
say.en: **in case** says what you do first, because it may happen: **Take a coat in case it rains.** **if** is different: **Take a coat if it rains.** For the past too: **I took a coat in case it rained.** In talk people also say *If I'd have listened*. Writing wants **If I had listened**.

examples.it: Prendi un cappotto, nel caso piova.

exercises.title: Jack rings the inn
exercises.text: — Where are you, Jack? — On the fell, and lost. If I ___ (bring) the map, I ___ (not be) here now. — If you ___ (listen) to the forecast, you'd be at home by the fire! — I know. If I ___ (know) these hills as well as you, I wouldn't have come this way. — Stay there. I'll come as long as the fog ___ (lift). I'll bring a torch in case it ___ (get) dark. Don't move unless you ___ (see) the path. If I'd known you were so far up, I ___ (set) off an hour ago.

translation.sl: — Kje si, Jack? — Na hribu, in izgubil sem se. Če bi vzel zemljevid, ne bi bil zdaj tu. — Če bi poslušal vremensko napoved, bi bil zdaj doma ob ognju! — Vem. Če bi poznal te hribe tako dobro kot ti, ne bi šel po tej poti. — Ostani tam. Pridem, če se le megla dvigne. Vzamem svetilko, za primer da se stemni. Ne premikaj se, če ne vidiš poti. Če bi vedel, da si tako visoko, bi šel na pot že pred eno uro.
translation.de: — Wo bist du, Jack? — Am Berg, und ich habe mich verirrt. Hätte ich die Karte mitgenommen, wäre ich jetzt nicht hier. — Hättest du den Wetterbericht gehört, wärst du jetzt daheim beim Feuer! — Ich weiß. Würde ich diese Berge so gut kennen wie du, wäre ich nicht hier gegangen. — Bleib dort. Ich komme, sofern sich der Nebel hebt. Ich nehme eine Lampe mit, falls es dunkel wird. Geh nicht weiter, außer du siehst den Weg. Hätte ich gewusst, dass du so weit oben bist, wäre ich vor einer Stunde losgegangen.
translation.it: — Dove sei, Jack? — Sul monte, e mi sono perso. Se avessi preso la cartina, adesso non sarei qui. — Se avessi ascoltato le previsioni, adesso saresti a casa accanto al fuoco! — Lo so. Se conoscessi queste colline bene come te, non sarei venuto di qui. — Resta lì. Vengo, purché la nebbia si alzi. Porto una torcia, nel caso faccia buio. Non muoverti, a meno che tu non veda il sentiero. Se avessi saputo che eri così in alto, sarei partito un'ora fa.
translation.en: — Where are you, Jack? — On the fell, and lost. If I had brought the map, I wouldn't be here now. — If you had listened to the forecast, you'd be at home by the fire! — I know. If I knew these hills as well as you, I wouldn't have come this way. — Stay there. I'll come as long as the fog lifts. I'll bring a torch in case it gets dark. Don't move unless you see the path. If I'd known you were so far up, I would have set off an hour ago.

exercises.title: At the Packhorse
exercises.text: If I ___ (not eat) all those scones, I wouldn't feel so ill now. Take your coat in case it ___ (snow). You can stay as long as you ___ (help) with the sheep. We won't start unless Jack ___ (come). If I ___ (be) younger, I'd have gone up with them.

translation.sl: Če ne bi {m:pojedel|f:pojedla} vseh tistih sconesov, mi zdaj ne bi bilo tako slabo. Vzemi plašč, za primer da bo snežilo. Lahko ostaneš, če le pomagaš pri ovcah. Ne bomo začeli, če Jack ne pride. Če bi bil{m:|f:a} {m:mlajši|f:mlajša}, bi {m:šel|f:šla} z njimi gor.
translation.de: Hätte ich nicht all die Scones gegessen, wäre mir jetzt nicht so schlecht. Nimm deinen Mantel mit, falls es schneit. Du kannst bleiben, solange du bei den Schafen hilfst. Wir fangen nicht an, außer Jack kommt. Wäre ich jünger, wäre ich mit ihnen hinaufgegangen.
translation.it: Se non avessi mangiato tutti quegli scone, adesso non starei così male. Prendi il cappotto, nel caso nevichi. Puoi restare, purché aiuti con le pecore. Non cominciamo, a meno che non venga Jack. Se fossi più giovane, sarei salit{m:o|f:a} con loro.
translation.en: If I hadn't eaten all those scones, I wouldn't feel so ill now. Take your coat in case it snows. You can stay as long as you help with the sheep. We won't start unless Jack comes. If I were younger, I'd have gone up with them.
